From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Morris <lena@vertigocap.com>
Cc: sre-team@vertigocap.com
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staged shelve & reinstate guidelines for Private upgrade (proposal)

Hi all,

Following our ops sync, attached is a proposed "staged shelve & reinstate" playbook for Vertigo's Private deployment upgrades. The goal is to give them a predictable way to accept security patches with minimal customer-visible risk and a clear, reversible path if anomalies occur.

Key points in the matrix (attached):
- Stage definition: Canary (5% traffic), Cohort A (25%), Cohort B (70%).
- Shelve action: move pinned nodes to a hold state (no new workloads), snapshot KV caches, mark metrics for short-term retention.
- Reinstate action: gradual rejoin with traffic ramp by percent and health-check gating.
- Abort/Deorbit: immediate unpin + snapshot rollback if x% error increase or latency > SLO for 10m.

Open questions for this thread:
1) Is the proposed abort threshold (5% 4xx/5xx delta or 30% tail latency delta) acceptable to Vertigo?
2) Do we need a separate network quiesce step for their on-prem gateway?
3) Who signs the go/no-go during the canary window (Vertigo SRE + Redwood ops)?

I've attached two files: shelve-reinstate-matrix.xlsx (detailed gating) and evacuation-checklist.pdf (operator checklist for a rapid deorbit). Please review and reply with edits or approvals.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachments: shelve-reinstate-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), evacuation-checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lena Morris <lena@vertigocap.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged shelve & reinstate guidelines for Private upgrade (proposal)

Thanks Mateo — good structure. A few inline notes: 

- Abort thresholds: can we make the error rule relative to baseline (e.g., +120% from last 24h median) rather than absolute 5%? For some of Vertigo's daily traffic, 5% is noisy.
- Network quiesce: for on-prem we should add an explicit step to coordinate with their perimeter firewall team to ensure BGP/ha-probes won't re-route during snapshot/drain. Suggest a 5-minute QUIESCE window prior to shelve.
- Reinstate: add a KV-priming step in stage 0 (read-only warm) so caches warm before traffic ramps.

Also flagging that we should define the stakeholder who clicks the revert — ops on-call + Vertigo SRE approval required. Karthik, Naomi — can you confirm?

Subject: Re: Staged shelve & reinstate guidelines for Private upgrade (proposal)

Hi all,

Appreciate the thoroughness. A few responses from Vertigo SRE side: 

- Abort thresholds: we prefer the relative baseline rule Soojin suggested (+120% from 24h median) and a secondary safety net of absolute 8% error increase for low-volume windows.
- Network quiesce: yes, we will coordinate an IP-announce short-hold with our perimeter team. We'll need a 10-minute lead so our firewall changes can propagate.
- Go/no-go: Vertigo SRE (on-call lead) + Redwood runbook owner must sign off. We'll nominate our on-call for the initial canary.

One ask: can Redwood add an automated metric snapshot (prometheus dump) right before shelve so we have immutable evidence for postmortem? That would help our auditors.

Subject: Re: Staged shelve & reinstate guidelines for Private upgrade (proposal)

Agree with the edits. Quick operational clarifications: 

- Metric snapshot: we can add an automated Prometheus dump and link it to the runbook step; we'll store it in the Vertigo drive folder for the window.
- QUIESCE timing: set to 10 minutes lead per Vertigo ask. We'll include a 10-minute fence and a 5-minute validation hold after shelve before starting traffic ramps.
- Revert authority: Redwood runbook owner (ops lead) + Vertigo on-call must both authorize an immediate deorbit; if they cannot agree within 7 minutes, auto-shelve to last pinned snapshot and route to Redwood escalation (director on-call).

Proposed final actions (for scheduling):
1) Update the matrix to use relative error thresholds (+120% baseline / fallback absolute 8%).
2) Add KV-priming stage 0 and automated Prometheus snapshot step.
3) Document QUIESCE 10m lead and 5m validation delay.
4) Schedule a dry-run with Vertigo next Tue at 03:00 UTC (low traffic).

If no objections, I'll push a revision to the Drive and we can confirm the dry-run time.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
